pr.title: fix(context): single body overrides other returns

summary: This PR only changes the TypeScript type signature of `Context#body` (converting `BodyRespond` to a generic overload so status codes are preserved individually, fixing #3798 where `c.body()` calls collapsed the union type in RPC client inference). The runtime implementation of `.body()` is functionally unchanged (same branching logic on `typeof arg === 'number'`), just re-typed with a cast to `ReturnType<BodyRespond>`. Test changes are cosmetic (renaming `let res` reuse to separate consts) plus a new type-only test verifying the status union is preserved.
